pass.answer: Root cause: `tests/test_campaigns.py::test_spring_campaign_rate` sets `pricing.RATES["standard"] = 0.1` and never restores it. pytest runs test_campaigns.py before test_pricing.py, so the standard rate is 10% by the time your test runs. Fix: use `monkeypatch.setitem(pricing.RATES, "standard", 0.1)`.
